title: Fine-joint information beyond reach phase

titles: Mouse M1/S1 reaching and grasping calcium, 3D kinematics and M1 inactivation

scientific_question: Do M1 and S1 encode joint configuration beyond target, movement phase and coarse limb displacement?
primary_outputs: Within-mouse area contrast in incremental kinematic prediction.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.
data_manifest.subject_count_evidence: Author archive description and pinned docs/SUMMARY.md. Optogenetic recordings use two additional named mouse files; not pooled with the imaging cohort.

recording_contract.neural: Trial R structs contain events and hasNeuralData; eventLockData returns time × ROI data. Raw/denoised calcium and RADICaL-derived variants are distinct allowed-input choices, not interchangeable raw spikes.
recording_contract.labels: R/M sources yield 3D marker positions and 24 joint angles/velocities, LR reach target and event intervals. Optogenetic trial labels are available for a separate behavioral intervention task.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Pinned eventLockData subtracts syncTime from event timestamps, aligns frameTimes using cycleDurMs and corrects ROILags. tPts and cycleDurMs use milliseconds; resampling to 10 ms does not create 100 Hz independent observations.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Imaging mice cfa17,cfa19,cfa20,cfa22,cfa24; two dated sessions per mouse, M1 and S1 per docs. R(1).animalID and timestamped filenames provide grouping. Separate optogenetic files cfaVG1/cfaVG4.
recording_contract.evidence: Published 13-file inventory; pinned loadData, eventLockData, loadLock4Decode, decode and SUMMARY inspected. Data schema comes from author source, not loaded MAT structures.

case_definition: One isolated biological-unit/session packet under the split policy; multiple scored observations are nested items, not independent biological cases.

split.policy: Group both M1/S1 sessions by mouse; whole reach trials; separate within-mouse and calibrated new-mouse conditions; PCA/neuron selection training only.
split.uncertainty: Biological-unit paired uncertainty where multiple units exist; single-animal/person tasks use descriptive session/trial blocks and do not imply population replication.

reference.role: Reference-analysis-only: decode.m performs PCA before cvRegress. A benchmark baseline must fit PCA and selection inside training folds; author result reproduction and leakage-safe prediction are different contracts.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Recomputed mouse-macro incremental explained variance with paired intervals.
observable_endpoints.investigation_rule: For investigations, recompute numerical claims and frozen held-out contrasts; the correct conclusion may be null or inconclusive. Do not score agreement with a favored biological story.

evaluation.comparability: Task variants and related outcomes share source/family evidence. Never sum task counts as independent cohorts or average unlike native metrics.
